upsert.title: Gold nanoparticles with near-infrared laser heating for superficial canine tumors
upsert.contacts: BARC clinical trials — 425-697-2272; contact through the official clinical trials page
upsert.funding: Funding varies by tumor cohort; confirm current owner costs with BARC.
upsert.notes: Gross-disease local treatment using IV gold nanoparticles followed by near-infrared laser heating. BARC currently lists dogs with large mast cell tumors (>2 cm), soft tissue sarcomas (<2 cm diameter), oral melanoma (2–3 cm diameter), and cutaneous or footpad melanoma (<2 cm). Tumor size and accessibility must be confirmed directly with BARC.

upsert.title: Gold nanoparticles with near-infrared laser heating for superficial feline tumors
upsert.contacts: BARC clinical trials — 425-697-2272; contact through the official clinical trials page
upsert.funding: Funding varies by tumor cohort; confirm current owner costs with BARC.
upsert.notes: Gross-disease local treatment using IV gold nanoparticles followed by near-infrared laser heating. BARC currently lists cats with oral squamous cell carcinoma not involving bone and cats with other cutaneous tumors such as mast cell tumors, sarcomas, or carcinomas. Tumor accessibility and full eligibility must be confirmed directly with BARC.

upsert.title: Long-acting intratumoral carboplatin for canine superficial squamous cell carcinoma
upsert.contacts: BARC clinical trials — 425-697-2272; contact through the official clinical trials page
upsert.funding: Fully funded. BARC states that all treatments and procedures associated with the clinical trial occur at no cost to the owner.
upsert.notes: Dogs must have cytologically or histologically confirmed SCC, at least one measurable lesion with longest diameter >=1.0 cm, and no evidence of metastasis based on thoracic radiographs and lymph-node evaluation. BARC also lists medical-comorbidity and prior-treatment exclusions; full eligibility requires study-team prescreening.

upsert.title: EGFR/HER2-targeted immunotherapy for canine EGFR-expressing tumors
upsert.contacts: BARC clinical trials — 425-697-2272; direct specialist referral may be accepted; contact through the official clinical trials page
upsert.funding: Public BARC page does not state a universal funding level for this active EGFR/HER2 immunotherapy program; confirm costs with BARC.
upsert.notes: Companion dogs with spontaneous EGFR-expressing tumors receive two peptide vaccines 3 weeks apart, followed by a blood draw for antigen-response analysis. BARC lists osteosarcoma, hemangiosarcoma, transitional cell carcinoma, pulmonary carcinoma (records review), and high-grade mast cell tumors (records review). Specialist referral can allow immunotherapy without a separate oncologist consultation; otherwise a BARC oncology consult may be used for review.

upsert.title: TLR 7/8/9 immunotherapy for gross sarcomas and carcinomas
upsert.status: Coming soon; BARC anticipates opening in September 2026
upsert.contacts: BARC clinical trials — 425-697-2272; contact through the official clinical trials page
upsert.funding: BARC states that all treatments and procedures associated with this clinical trial will occur at no cost to the owner.
upsert.notes: BARC describes a planned immunotherapy study for gross-disease sarcomas and carcinomas and anticipates opening enrollment in September 2026. The public listing does not yet provide detailed eligibility criteria. Do not match to owners until BARC confirms enrollment is open.

upsert.title: Randomized fecal transplant capsules with Palladia for multiple canine tumor types
upsert.contacts: BARC clinical trials — 425-697-2272; contact through the official clinical trials page
upsert.funding: Funding details are not yet stated on the public BARC listing; confirm owner costs when enrollment opens.
upsert.notes: Planned randomized study for dogs starting Palladia (toceranib). Dogs will receive fecal-transplant capsules or placebo capsules while all participants receive active Palladia; samples are collected during the first 3 months. Do not match to owners until BARC confirms enrollment is open.
